Copies of an old art work called '''''Clone Wars Painting''''' were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted the helmet-covered face of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]&mdash;one of the many [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="SWG" />&mdash;in [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase I clone trooper armor]];<ref name="INSIDER">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> behind the off-center trooper was a landscape that featured an [[Color/Legends|orange]] mountain range and sky. The original painting was commissioned by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Farnsworth]], who rewarded it to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] that helped [[Gender/Legends|him]] recover survey data from markers placed around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. A copy of the painting was rewarded to a spacer after they killed twelve [[snorbal]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], at the challenge of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter [[Qakkee]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The painting of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It was added to the game in [[2005]] as part of the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] expansion pack as one of the many new quest rewards. The painting was specifically a reward from a part of the long chain of quests known collectively as the "Clone Relics" and from the "Collecting Survey Data" quest. It was named simply "Clone Wars Painting" in the game, a name it shares with a [[Clone Wars Painting (Grievous)|similar painting]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
